8 October 2026. Reconstructed theorem candidate; external correctness and historical priority UNKNOWN.
Original derivation frozen before blind-audit exposure in ORIGINAL_DERIVATION_FROZEN.txt.

RESULT
For the mass-action CTMC on N_0^2 with reactions
  0 -> B              rate lambda,
  B -> A              rate lambda*b,
  A+2B -> 0           rate kappa*a*b*(b-1),
where lambda,kappa>0 are fixed, the entire state space is irreducible and the process is nonexplosive. It is transient if kappa<2lambda and null recurrent if kappa>=2lambda. There is no invariant probability distribution for any kappa.
The rate convention is the falling factorial b(b-1), without a 1/2. With binomial propensity kappa*a*binom(b,2), the threshold is kappa=4lambda.
This closes the explicitly unclassified mu=lambda line of MR1 in state/2026-10-08-stochastic-universality/RESULT_AND_RESTART.md. It is a concrete phase diagram for a single irreducible component, not a claim about uniform tightness over distinct components. The network is not weakly reversible, so it does not resolve or refute the weakly reversible recurrence conjecture.

The deterministic system a'=lambda*b-kappa*a*b^2, b'=lambda-lambda*b-2kappa*a*b^2 has the unique globally attracting positive equilibrium (3lambda/kappa,1/3). Its strong endotacticity and permanence are already covered by established results. The new mathematical deduction is the critical stochastic classification, especially the exact second threshold inside the zero-speed line. Novelty remains unverified.

Every (a,b) reaches (a+b,0) by conversions. From (a,0) with a>=1, two immigrations followed by annihilation reach (a-1,0). Hence every state reaches (0,0). INDEPENDENT CRITICAL CRN AUDIT
Frozen independent derivation, 2026-10-08. No other worker argument or repository candidate proof was read before this report was written. Exact rates, including the factor b(b-1), are essential.

RESULT
Let lambda,kappa>0 and let (A_t,B_t) have transitions
 (a,b)->(a,b+1) at rate lambda,
 (a,b)->(a+1,b-1) at rate lambda*b,
 (a,b)->(a-1,b-2) at rate kappa*a*b*(b-1).
The chain on N_0^2 is nonexplosive and irreducible. Put r=lambda/kappa.

1. If 0<r<=1/2 (equivalently kappa>=2 lambda), it is null recurrent.
2. If r>1/2 (equivalently kappa<2 lambda), it is transient.
3. It is never positive recurrent on this equality of birth and conversion coefficients. Therefore there is no stationary probability distribution and no stationary probability tail to report. A sigma-finite invariant measure in the null recurrent cases is not a stationary probability law.

The embedded full jump chain and the return chain on b=0 have the same null-recurrent/transient classification here. The continuous-time conclusion is proved below using the actual clock; it is not inferred from recurrence of an arbitrary time change.

Status: internally reconstructed proof. No external validation or novelty/priority claim. A finite exact recursion is an independent diagnostic of the calculated coefficients, not the proof.

Realize immigration by a rate-lambda Poisson clock. Let I(t),C(t),D(t) be the numbers of immigration, conversion, and annihilation jumps up to t. Conservation of B gives

so C(t)+D(t)<=B_0+I(t). Consequently total jumps up to t are at most B_0+2I(t), which is finite almost surely on every finite interval. This establishes nonexplosion without any bound on the potentially large annihilation rate.
